description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'MoveList' that displays a list of chess moves, along with game status indicators such as checkmate or stalemate. It also includes a private widget '_StatusPill' for status display.

classes.name: MoveList
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a list of chess moves with game status indicators.

classes.name: _StatusPill
classes.description: A private stateless widget that displays a colored label indicating game status such as 'Checkmate' or 'Stalemate'.

methods.description: Builds the MoveList widget UI, including move list and status indicators.

methods.description: Builds the UI for the status pill with label and color.
